caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular outline with several internal pencil-drawn shapes representing pattern pieces for garment construction, labeled with letters and numbers. Within the upper half of the rectangle, two large rectangular sections labeled "I" and "J" dominate the composition, positioned side by side with a vertical line separating them and a zigzag line adjacent to the separation. Both rectangles have irregular, jagged upper edges, suggesting gathers or pleats. Below these rectangles, a series of smaller pattern piece outlines are overlaid, irregularly shaped and arranged to fit within the lower section of the larger rectangle. Various sections are labeled with capital letters from A to L. Curved, double lines resembling ties or drawstrings extend from the center of the lower section, and multiple short, straight lines project downward, possibly indicating pleats or gathers. Along the left, right, and bottom edges of the large rectangle are handwritten labels denoting "CENTER FRONT," "CENTER BACK," and additional annotation areas. In the lower center part of the drawing, there is a list of lettered keys (A–L), each followed by a short description of the particular garment piece or construction step, written in small, neat handwriting. The drawing is rendered in a monochromatic, light pencil on an off-white or aged beige paper background.
title: Dress (Pattern)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
